scope: Owned JWM entry launches accepted 2048 in xterm; real movement/restart/quit and relaunch; screenshots require independent review

menu.menu:
<JWM>
<Program label="Terminal">xterm -fn fixed -title Terminal</Program>
<Program label="Calculator">xcalc -fn fixed</Program>
<Program label="Text editor">xedit -xrm "*font: fixed"</Program>
<Program label="Clock">xclock -update 1</Program>
<Program label="Eyes">xeyes</Program>
<Program label="2048">/usr/local/bin/desktop-menu launch gucos-desktop-2048.desktop</Program>
<Program label="Calculator">/usr/local/bin/desktop-menu launch gucos-desktop-xcalc.desktop</Program>
<Program label="Clock">/usr/local/bin/desktop-menu launch gucos-desktop-xclock.desktop</Program>
<Program label="Text Editor">/usr/local/bin/desktop-menu launch gucos-desktop-xedit.desktop</Program>
<Program label="Eyes">/usr/local/bin/desktop-menu launch gucos-desktop-xeyes.desktop</Program>
</JWM>
